title: The comparison test for series of nonnegative terms
statement: forall a b, (forall k, le zero (a k)) -> (forall k, le (a k) (b k)) -> (Exists M, Converges (sumRange b) M) -> Exists L, Converges (sumRange a) L -- the comparison test as usually stated (pointwise 0 <= a k <= b k, sum b convergent), built by converting to sumRange_converges_of_dominated's Cauchy-hypothesis form: 0 <= a k and a k <= b k combine into abs (a k) <= b k via abs_le, and the witness M in the convergent-b hypothesis is eliminated into Cauchy (sumRange b) before that theorem is applied directly.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.sumRange_comparisonTest : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : AxNat) -> CReal.le CReal.zero (x0 x2))) -> ((x3 : ((x3 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (x0 x3) (x1 x3))) -> ((x4 : Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x4 : CReal) => CReal.Converges (CReal.sumRange x1) x4)) -> Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x5 : CReal) => CReal.Converges (CReal.sumRange x0) x5))))))
